name: Polynomial Energy Masking
description: Replaces the geometric tangency condition (which trivially simplifies to $c_u + c_v = 3$) with a quadratic Diophantine-style equation $2c_u^2 + 5c_uc_v + 2c_v^2 = 20$. Over the domain $\{1, 2\}$, this equation is satisfied if and only if $c_u \neq c_v$. Models that rely on surface pattern matching of graph coloring or geometric phrasing will fail to recognize that this is just a bipartiteness check.
